nodes.description: A patent publication titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method for diagnosis assistance using similarity between medical cases and experts in a common embedding space.

nodes.entity_id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
nodes.description: The title of patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based approach for assisting medical diagnosis.
nodes.id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance

nodes.description: A method that exploits similarity between a new medical case and existing medical cases and experts embedded in a common embedding space, supporting query-by-cases and query-by-experts.

A common space in which a new medical case, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded as multidimensional representations used to compute similarity.<SEP>A multidimensional space in which existing medical cases, experts, and new medical cases are represented as multidimensional representations.

A medical case submitted by a requester as part of a query request, which is embedded in the embedding space for comparison with existing cases and experts.<SEP>A case for which a diagnosis is sought, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, such as laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, and prescribed medications and treatments.

A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space and used as candidates returned in a query-for-cases.<SEP>A set of prior medical cases embedded in the embedding space and used for similarity comparison with a new medical case.

A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space whose representations are compared with a new case to return a subset in a query-for-experts.<SEP>A set of experts each embedded in the embedding space based on information such as expert profiles, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and stored medical cases linked to the expert.
The party submitting a query request including a new medical case and selecting from available query types.<SEP>A user who submits a query request including a new medical case to the system.

A query type that returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type in which a subset of existing cases is returned based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.<SEP>A query type in which a subset of experts is returned based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.
A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases.

An ontology comprising a set of medical concepts joined by links, used to compute multidimensional representations of medical cases and experts.<SEP>An ontology that includes parts of the human body, biological functions, medical conditions, pharmacological substances, and combinations thereof, and may be based on the Unified Medical Language System.
Concepts in the medical ontology, each corresponding to a respective dimension in the multidimensional representation.
A representation of a medical case computed based on the medical ontology, with each medical concept corresponding to a dimension.

A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity.<SEP>A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of a new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
A processor used to perform at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps.
Parts of the human body included in the medical ontology.
Biological functions included in the medical ontology.
Medical conditions included in the medical ontology.
Pharmacological substances included in the medical ontology.
A medical ontology system on which the medical ontology used in the method is based.

A system comprising memory storing instructions and a processor for executing them, which receives query requests, embeds new medical cases, provides query type selection, returns subsets of cases or experts, and computes query costs.
A set of devices in a network for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.
A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.

A computed measure of similarity between the representation of a new case and representations of existing cases or experts, wherein a matrix of proximities accounting for relationships between concepts in the ontology is applied.
The determination formulated by an expert to whom a new case is provided.
A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis.
A database from which documents are returned based on a computed similarity between the embedded new case and documents embedded in the embedding space.
A specific patient to whom the plurality of records of a new medical case relate.
